name: Shizuki Rin
source:
A girl who had a cruel past of being sold into service.
She was soon bought and freed by her current teacher Iori.
She started training herself daily in martial arts, and is currently working as a spy.
She has a calm personality unbecoming of her age and is not afraid to say things bluntly.
